`sscanf()` and `fscanf()` lower to calls to `__elephc_scanf` / `__elephc_fscanf`, PHP functions the
scanf prelude declares. No PHP source ever names them, so the declaration-reachability pass finds
nothing pointing at them and prunes them — and the backend then meets a call to a function that no
longer exists. EVERY `sscanf()` and `fscanf()` in any form fails to compile.
